notes: Cutnote 2.0: the Music tab, a fresh pure-black look, sliding controls, banners, pressable shortcuts and one-click updates all come together in one release.
Smoother first play: every clip loads ahead of time, so a video no longer freezes for a moment the first time a new shot starts.
Nicer track switches: the eye and speaker on each track are round buttons that ease on hover and animate as they turn off and on.
Centred play buttons: the play triangle now sits optically centred in every play button.
